properties.name: CorridorRides
properties.units: Benton County; Iowa County; Johnson County; Jones County; Linn County; Washington County
properties.note: Six-county service; within Linn and Johnson counties, service within 3/4 mi of fixed bus routes restricted to elderly/disabled (paratransit); majority of area is general-public

properties.name: DART On Demand
properties.note: No published zone acreage/sq-mi figure found (checked ridedart.com/dart-demand-ankeny and ridedart.com/services); zone is a bounded sub-area of Ankeny defined by streets (NE 62nd Ave south, SE Four Mile Dr east, 36th St north, SW Irvinedale Dr west), so city limits are used as an approximate containing-unit proxy, not an exact match. Planned expansion to Clive, Urbandale, and Altoona zones fall 2026. Source: https://www.ridedart.com/dart-demand-ankeny

properties.name: EASE (East Ames Service Extension)
properties.note: East Ames on-demand zone within city limits; includes pickups at Ames City Hall for transfers

properties.name: HIRTA On-Demand
properties.units: Boone County; Dallas County; Jasper County; Madison County; Marion County; Story County; Warren County
properties.note: Door-to-door service across seven-county region; FTA ITS4US deployment site

properties.name: MIDAS Regional Transit
properties.units: Calhoun County; Hamilton County; Humboldt County; Pocahontas County; Webster County; Wright County
properties.note: Six-county Region 5 service; general public confirmed on operator website; same-day available at premium fare

properties.name: NTS (Neighborhood Transportation Service)
properties.units: Cedar Rapids city; Marion city; Hiawatha city
properties.note: Service covers three named cities in Linn County. Operates during hours when fixed-route buses don't run.

properties.name: Peoplerides
properties.units: Hardin County; Marshall County; Poweshiek County; Tama County
properties.note: Four-county service; Marshalltown paratransit requires prior approval; Medicaid trips via MTM broker

properties.name: Region 8 Regional Transit Authority (RTA) On-Demand
properties.units: Delaware County; Dubuque County; Jackson County
properties.note: Delaware and Jackson counties are full-county service. Dubuque County unit is approximate only: RTA8 explicitly excludes the City of Dubuque, which is served instead by a separate city transit provider (The Jule); RTA8 covers the rest (rural/small-town) Dubuque County. The resolver has no county-minus-city subtraction, so the Dubuque County polygon here includes the excluded city area. Source: https://rta8.org/ and https://www.eciatrans.org/rpa8/transit.php (RPA8/DMATS split between RTA8 and The Jule).

properties.name: RIDES (Region 3 Regional Transit Authority)
properties.units: Buena Vista County; Clay County; Dickinson County; Emmet County; Lyon County; O'Brien County; Osceola County; Palo Alto County; Sioux County
properties.note: Nine-county NW Iowa service; general public confirmed on operator website

properties.name: River Bend Transit
properties.units: Cedar County; Clinton County; Muscatine County; Scott County
properties.note: Iowa Quad Cities region; regional consolidated transit system est. 1978

properties.name: Southern Iowa Trolley
properties.units: Adair County; Adams County; Clarke County; Decatur County; Ringgold County; Taylor County; Union County
properties.note: Seven-county SW Iowa service; in-town service in Corning, Creston, Greenfield, Leon, Mt. Ayr, Osceola plus connectors; Bedford available on request

properties.name: SWITA (Southwest Iowa Transit Agency)
properties.units: Cass County; Fremont County; Harrison County; Mills County; Montgomery County; Page County; Pottawattamie County; Shelby County
properties.note: Eight-county SW Iowa service; on-demand 6am-5pm weekdays

properties.name: Trip Connect (Johnson County)
properties.units: Iowa City city; Coralville city; University Heights city; North Liberty city; Tiffin city
properties.note: Service is explicitly within city limits of Iowa City, Coralville, University Heights, North Liberty, and Tiffin, plus pickup/dropoff at other locations north of I-80 in Johnson County (evening service, 5pm-midnight) — not the full county (1,615 km²), which would overstate coverage south of I-80. The unincorporated north-of-I-80 area outside these five cities is not separately mappable with available resolver boundary_types, so this uses the five named cities as an approximate proxy that captures the core of the service area. Pilot ended June 30, 2026. Source: https://www.johnsoncountyiowa.gov/node/14198 and https://www.johnsoncountyiowa.gov/sites/default/files/2025-01/Trip%20Connect%20Flyer.pdf
